name: seed-lang
description: Syntax highlighting, editor settings and the seed lsp language server for the Seed language (.sd files)

seed.path.description: The seed binary that runs the language server (`seed lsp`): seed on the PATH after make install, or the absolute path of build/seed2.

seed.languageServer.enabled.description: Start the language server (diagnostics, formatting, go to definition, hover, completion, outline). Takes effect after a reload.

seed.trace.server.description: Log the messages between VS Code and the language server in the Output panel (Seed language server).
